messages:
sam: Quick review of the Docs drawer on Dashboard > Routes. Noticed a couple of UX/copy/accessibility mismatches.
rachel: drop the items here and we'll triage.
sam: 1) Vocabulary: UI uses 'variant' in a few places but the docs use 'flavor' and 'model flavor' appears in the examples. This trips up support. Suggest canonicalize to 'variant' and add a one-line glossary in the drawer.
tony: +1 for 'variant' since it's in the API. small PR to docs should fix examples.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened docs PR #521 to replace 'flavor' with 'variant' in examples: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/521
sam: 2) Deeplinks: the drawer's "Learn" link lands at the top of the doc. users expect the routing-policy section. Can we add anchors and surface a chevron that jumps to the exact section?
aria: accessibility: the chevron should be keyboard reachable and have aria-label="Open docs: routing policy". Also the link should include a short hidden summary for screen readers.
tony: will coordinate with docs to add stable anchors. we should also detect if anchor exists; fallback to doc root.
sam: 3) CTA text: current button reads "Read docs". ambiguous. For small contextual cards, prefer "See routing examples"; for overview cards, "Open docs".
rachel: sounds sensible. we'll default to context-specific when possible.
aria: keyboard/focus: when drawer opens, move focus to the panel heading. on close, return focus to the trigger. ensure Escape closes the panel on all browsers.
tony: noted. i'll add an acceptance test for Safari + Firefox keyboard behavior.
sam: layout: if we add glossary + extra buttons, mobile can get crowded. propose footer transforms into an expandable disclosure under 480px.
rachel: timeline: tony to draft implementation plan + small spec with ARIA bits by EOD; aria to run checklist after demo; sam to handle copy mapping.
aria: i can help with a 10min voiceover test once the PR is up.
sam: thanks all, ping this thread when the PRs are ready. :thumbsup
thread_summary: Short product thread: standardize 'variant' vs 'flavor', add section anchors for direct deeplinks, improve CTA wording, ensure keyboard focus/ESC behavior, add mini-glossary and mobile disclosure. docs-bot linked a PR.
